title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 27: the bonds and bars on Jeremiah's neck, the call to serve the king of Babylon, and the vessels of Yahweh's house.

questions.text: According to verse 1, in the beginning of whose reign did this word come to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens: in the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh.

answers.text: Josiah the son of Amon
Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told to make and put on his neck?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck."

answers.text: A chain of silver
A linen belt
A basket of figs
Bonds and bars

questions.text: To the kings of which peoples was Jeremiah told to send them, by the hand of the messengers who came to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He was to send them to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the children of Ammon, the king of Tyre and the king of Sidon.

answers.text: Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon
Egypt, Elam, Uz and Dedan
Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron and Ashdod
Babylon, Media and Arabia

questions.text: What did Yahweh say He had made by His great power and outstretched arm?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me."

answers.text: The sun, the moon and the stars
The covenant with their fathers
The earth, the men and the animals on it
The city and its walls

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh say He had given all these lands?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant," and that He had also given the animals of the field to him.

answers.text: Into the hand of the king of Tyre
Into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon
Into the hand of the king of Judah
Into the hand of the messengers from the nations

questions.text: According to verse 7, how long would all the nations serve Nebuchadnezzar?
questions.explanation: The text says all the nations would serve him, his son, and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings would make him their bondservant.

answers.text: Only two full years, and then the yoke would be broken
Until the next harvest had been gathered in all the land
Until the city of Jerusalem had been rebuilt by its king
Through him, his son and his son's son, until the time of his own land comes

questions.text: Whom were the nations told not to listen to?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Don't listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers," who said they should not serve the king of Babylon.

answers.text: Their prophets, diviners, soothsayers and sorcerers
The messengers who came to Jerusalem
The priests who served in Yahweh's house
The elders of their own land and city

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise the nation that brought its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and served him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that nation He would let remain in their own land, and they would till it and dwell in it.

answers.text: That it would rule over the other nations
That its prophets would be proved true
That He would let it remain in its own land
That it would pay no tribute

questions.text: What lie were the prophets telling about the vessels of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said not to listen to the prophets who said, "Behold, the vessels of Yahweh's house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon," for they prophesied a lie.

answers.text: That they had been broken in pieces
That they would shortly be brought back from Babylon
That they were hidden in the king's house
That new vessels would be made of iron

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen to the vessels that were still left in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they would be carried to Babylon and would be there until the day that He visits them; then He would bring them up and restore them to this place.

answers.text: They would be carried to Babylon, and later brought back and restored
They would stay in Yahweh's house and be untouched
They would be given to the king of Sidon and to Tyre
They would be melted down for the king of Babylon
